tool_input.description: Generate coverage manifest of all checks

result:
The audit of `/catalogue/` is complete. The validator passed 58 of 58 checks with 0 missing, unknown, duplicate, blocked or not-run. The page is a static product listing with no JavaScript: a search box, three product cards, page links, and an "add to cart" form.

**Scorecard**

```
Overall: 86/100 (needs work)

Speed & Stability      95  good
Memory Health         100  good
Usability & UX         72  needs work
Inclusivity & Reach    83  needs work
Discoverability & AI   85  needs work
Trust & Resilience     78  needs work

Do these first:
  1. [critical] Make search, the page links, the cart page and "add to cart" actually work, and point the "Catalogue" link at /catalogue/
  2. [high] Put an "Add to cart" button on each product card and show the part numbers
  3. [medium] Show prices including VAT on every card (or "Price on request")
```

The interactive report is at `reports-cpa/127_0_0_1_8765/scorecard.html`. Its History tab now holds three runs, but they audit three different pages on this host (`/booking/`, `/account-recovery/` and `/catalogue/`). Read the changes there as different pages, not one page improving.

**Main findings**
- **Nothing on the page leads anywhere.** Searching shows a bare "Error 404" page, and pages 1–3 and the Cart link also return 404. "Add to cart" fails with "501 Unsupported method", and the "Catalogue" link opens a raw list of server folders. This server is a static test setup, so production may behave differently.
- **"Add to cart" asks for a part number the page never shows.** The product cards have no part number, no button and no link.
- **No prices anywhere**, even though the footer says "Catalogue prices include VAT."
- **The layout pushes the products aside.** They sit in the narrow side column, while the search box takes the wide one. The page links end up under the search box, away from the results they page through.
- **Failure pages offer no way back.** They have no site header, no navigation and no explanation, and anything typed is lost.

Also reported:
- The cart form can be submitted empty and gives no inline error messages.
- The "you are here" marker for screen readers sits on two links that go elsewhere.
- Heading levels jump from the page title straight to the product names.
- There is no dark mode.
- Buttons lose their outline in high-contrast mode.
- The text size is fixed at 16px, ignoring the user's setting.
- There are no security headers, the cart form posts over plain HTTP, and it has no protection against forged requests.
- There is no page description, product data for search engines, or sitemap.
- The stylesheet is sent uncompressed and is never cached.

Everything is in `reports-cpa/127_0_0_1_8765/2026-10-09T00-27-28-894Z/` (`report.json`, `report.md`, `evidence/`), and I updated `latest.txt` to point at it. One leftover file, `evidence/after-add-to-cart.png`, was taken before the form submission finished. Deleting it needed approval, so it is still there. It is not referenced as evidence. Nothing was committed, and I made no source changes because this was report-only mode.

**TLDR:** All 58 checks judged (21 issues, 28 pass, 9 not applicable), producing 20 findings: 1 critical, 1 high, 7 medium and 11 low. Evidence came from:
- screenshots at desktop, wide, phone, dark and high-contrast settings, plus the pages each link leads to
- the axe accessibility scanner, the accessibility tree with a real Tab walk, and touch-target sizes
- a CSS feature check, layout, and a slowed-down mobile performance trace
- a network recording, security headers, cookies, trackers and a secrets scan
- a check of what search crawlers see, a reload with the network off, and before/after memory snapshots
- my own probe of the forms and every link and form destination, a run under an Arabic locale and Tokyo time zone, and the Modern Web Guidance and Baseline lookups

The single highest-leverage fix is making search, the page links and the cart work, because right now every journey from this page ends at an error.
